page.overview:
Who is Black Dragon?

Black Dragon is a ninja specializing in stealth and night missions. His effectiveness at tracking is enhanced by his "sixth sense". Normally silent, his few words are always worth heeding.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2| G.I. Joe Extreme

Black Dragon was released in 1995. He and Harpoon were the only figures from the second wave to be released and were produced in lower numbers than the other figures. ---- Appearance:
